meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 它会扫描你 Azure 上的 Functions 和 App Service 资源,出一张按可靠性功能排列的检查表(区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探测、多区域故障转移)并标出缺口;你确认后,它按阶段用 CLI 命令或改 IaC 文件来修。
howto.when: 当你说「评估可靠性」「检查可靠性」「区域冗余」等关键词,或要求找单点故障、查灾难恢复准备时触发。目前只覆盖 Azure Functions 和 App Service。

say.text: 评估我这个 Function app 的可靠性
say.note: 先给出功能检查表,不会直接改资源

say.text: 让我的应用服务计划开启区域冗余
say.note: 动手前会先列出改动并让你确认

say.text: 查一下我这个资源组有没有单点故障

howto.what_en: It scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources, prints a feature-pivoted reliability checklist (zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, multi-region failover) with gaps flagged, then after your confirmation fixes them in stages via CLI commands or IaC patches.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to assess or check reliability, zone redundancy, high availability, multi-region failover, single points of failure or disaster recovery readiness. Currently covers Azure Functions and App Service only.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function app
say_en.note: Prints the checklist first, changes nothing

say_en.text: Make my App Service plan zone redundant
say_en.note: Lists the changes and asks before acting

say_en.text: Find single points of failure in my resource group
say_en.note: Needs az login and the resource-graph extension
